description: Encryption round-trip (pdfnative v1.6): generate a PDF, re-secure it with AES-256 (owner + user password) via encrypt_pdf, confirm the cipher with inspect_pdf (password required), then recover an unencrypted copy with decrypt_pdf. NOTE: encrypt_pdf / decrypt_pdf rebuild the page tree, so signatures and AcroForms are dropped — encrypt BEFORE signing. To merely READ an encrypted PDF, pass `password` to inspect_pdf / extract_text instead of decrypting. Replace the <base64…> placeholders with the bytes returned by each prior step.
